title: How 2 Second-Year Backs Must REPLACE a Cleveland Browns Legend's 6,843-Yard Legacy
description:
The Cleveland Browns are asking two second-year running backs to do the impossible: replace Nick Chubb's legendary 6,843-yard legacy. Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson could not be more different from each other or from the franchise icon they're replacing. We break down the massive gamble Cleveland is making at running back, what it reveals about their identity crisis, and whether Judkins and Sampson can escape the shadow of the greatest Browns running back since Jim Brown.

With Todd Monken installing a Baltimore-style offense, a rebuilt offensive line, and an unsettled quarterback competition, the Browns are betting everything on two unproven backs who combined for barely 1,000 yards as rookies. This Saturday's preseason opener against the Bears will give us our first real look at whether this gamble can pay off.
